newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: DAS Air Cargo to start weekly freighter to Bahrain.
newsitem.headline: DAS Air Cargo to start weekly freighter to Bahrain.

text.p: DAS Air Cargo plans a weekly DC10 freighter service to Bahrain, the Gulf Arab state's Civil Aviation Affairs said in a statement.
"The air cargo sector (in Bahrain) is set for expansion as...DAS introduces its weekly freighter service to Bahrain," the statement said. It did not say when flights would start.
It said DAS flight DSR 607 would leave Gatwick on Sundays at 1400 local and would arrive in Bahrain at 2030 local
DAS, a rapidly expanding cargo airline, plans to introduce a second frequency for the winter, it added. -- Bahrain newsroom 973-524424
